description: This file contains the implementation of the Response interface, specifically the ResponseImpl class. It manages a collection of LoggerData objects mapped to Double values, along with a timestamp indicating when the response was created. The class provides methods to set data values, retrieve the set of data, fetch specific data values, and get the timestamp.

classes.name: ResponseImpl
classes.description: Implementation of the Response interface that stores LoggerData-value pairs and a timestamp.

methods.name: ResponseImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing the timestamp to the current system time.

methods.name: setDataValue
methods.description: Sets the value for a given LoggerData object.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns a set of LoggerData keys stored in the response.

methods.name: getDataValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific LoggerData object, returning 0.0 if not present.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp when the ResponseImpl instance was created.
